findings.location: Definition, first paragraph: clauses defining a_clean(C) and a_dirty(C).
findings.evidence: The definition assigns clean/dirty counts to a generic circuit C without specifying the ancilla-contract interface. The cited def-qc-clean-and-dirty-ancillas requires declared data and ancilla registers and a target unitary V_D; def-qc-promise-computation-model only declares zero-initialized auxiliary wires and imposes no return-to-zero condition or target data unitary. The item does not specify when these coordinates apply versus when they are not applicable. Require the relevant contract data in the cost-model instance, or mark these coordinates not applicable when that interface is absent.

coverage_note: Reviewed all batch 14 pages and items and the supplier items needed for their claims. The A page lists 17 prerequisite pages; I did not audit those page bodies. Out-of-batch consumers of the shared cost-model definition were not audited; the Markdown report records this scope limit, the repairs, and the run blocker.
